root_overlay_init:
#!/bin/sh
### BEGIN INIT INFO
# Provides:       mount-overlayfs
# Default-Start:  S
# Default-Stop:
# Description:    Mount Overlayfs
### END INIT INFO

case "$1" in
    start|"")
        if [ ! -d /system ];then
            mkdir -p /system
        fi
        # clear the overlayfs
        if [ ! -f /oem/.debug ]; then
            echo "reset overlayfs"
            rm -rf /oem/overlay/*
        fi

        if [ ! -d /oem/overlay/upper ];then
            mkdir -p /oem/overlay/upper
        fi
        if [ ! -d /oem/overlay/work ];then
            mkdir -p /oem/overlay/work
        fi
        chmod 0755 /oem/overlay/upper
        chmod 0755 /oem/overlay/work
        mount --bind -n / /overlay
        mount -t overlay overlay -o noatime,lowerdir=/overlay,upperdir=/oem/overlay/upper,workdir=/oem/overlay/work /system
        mount -n /proc --move /system/proc
        pivot_root /system /system/overlay
        mount -n /overlay/dev --move /dev
        mount -n /overlay/tmp --move /tmp
        mount -n /overlay/run --move /run
        mount -n /overlay/sys --move /sys
        mount -o noatime,move /overlay/oem /oem
        mount -o noatime,move /overlay/userdata /userdata
        # mount -n /overlay/overlay --move /overlay
        ;;
    restart|reload|force-reload)
        # No-op
        ;;
    stop|status)
        # No-op
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: start" >&2
        exit 3
        ;;
esac
